rows.ARS: Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jacques Mouchotte (France, 2007).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) as 'California Dreamin''.
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 2009 as 'California Dreamin''.
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink edges. Strong, citrus fragrance. 28 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters, cupped, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact. Dark green foliage. 3 to 5 leaflets.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 21,388 on 19 Oct 2010 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 12/379,445 on 23 Feb 2009
Inventors: Meilland; Alain A. (Antibes, FR)

The female parent (i.e., the seed parent) was the `Meimagarmic` variety (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 5,067). The `Meimagarmic` variety sometimes is marketed under the PRINCESSE DE MONACO Trademark. The male parent (i.e., the pollen parent) was the product of the cross of the `Meihelvet` variety (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 3,095) and the `Korsee` variety (non-patented in the United States).
